title: Learning from Noisy Preferences: A Semi-Supervised Learning Approach to Direct Preference Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2604.24952v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Human visual preferences are inherently multi-dimensional, encompassing aesthetics, detail fidelity, and semantic alignment. However, existing datasets provide only single, holistic annotations, resulting in severe label noise: images that excel in some dimensions but are deficient in others are simply marked as winner or loser. We theoretically demonstrate that compressing multi-dimensional preferences into binary labels generates conflicting gradient signals that misguide Diffusion Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). To address this, we propose Semi-DPO, a semi-supervised approach that treats consistent pairs as clean labeled data and conflicting ones as noisy unlabeled data. Our method starts by training on a consensus-filtered clean subset, then uses this model as an implicit classifier to generate pseudo-labels for the noisy set for iterative refinement. translated_title: 从噪声偏好中学习：一种直接偏好优化的半监督学习方法
translated_abstract: 人类视觉偏好本质上是多维的，涵盖美学、细节保真度和语义对齐等方面。然而，现有数据集仅提供单一的、整体性的标注，导致严重的标签噪声：在某些维度上表现出色但在其他维度上存在缺陷的图像被简单地标记为赢家或输家。我们从理论上证明，将多维偏好压缩为二元标签会产生相互矛盾的梯度信号，从而误导扩散直接偏好优化（DPO）。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Semi-DPO，一种半监督方法，它将一致的偏好对视为干净的标注数据，将冲突的偏好对视为有噪声的无标注数据。我们的方法首先在经过共识过滤的干净子集上进行训练，然后将该模型用作隐式分类器，为噪声数据集生成伪标签以进行迭代优化。实验结果表明，Semi-DPO达到了最先进的性能水平。
tldr: 提出Semi-DPO半监督方法，将一致偏好对视为干净数据、冲突偏好对视为噪声数据，通过伪标签迭代优化，解决了多维人类偏好被压缩为二元标签时产生的梯度冲突问题，从而提升扩散模型直接偏好优化的效果。
en_tdlr: Semi-DPO, a semi-supervised approach that treats consistent preference pairs as clean labeled data and conflicting ones as noisy unlabeled data with iterative pseudo-label refinement, resolves the gradient conflicts caused by compressing multi-dimensional human preferences into binary labels in Diffusion Direct Preference Optimization.
